sys_properties_category.name: Xalient ISC Configuration
sys_properties_category.title:
Welcome to the Xalient Identity Security Cloud configuration page. Below is an explanation of the system properties available in this page

  • ISC Tenant name - This is the first part in the URL
  • ISC Domain - This is the part of the URL just before the .com
  • Client Id - The id of the OAuth client that you defined. This is most often in the form of a Personal Access Token or PAT
  • Client Secret - The secret for your defined OAuth client
  • Approval Fallback Group - This is the group that will receive approvals in a circumstance where an approver cannot be found
  • Task Assignment Group - The group that will receive SCTASK assignments by default
  • Incident Assignment Group - The group that will receive INCIDENT assignments by default
